name: MDC
summary: 3,4-Methylenedioxycathinone (MDC, MDCATH), also known as β-keto-3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (β-keto-MDA or βk-MDA), is an entactogen and stimulant drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and cathinone families related to methylone (βk-MDMA or MDMC). It is the β-keto analogue of MDA.

pharmacology.text: Like methylone, MDC is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

uses.en: It is mainly of research interest, partly as a breakdown product of methylone. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它主要具研究價值，部分原因是它是甲酮的代謝物。它沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它主要具研究价值，部分原因是它是甲酮的代谢物。它没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related cathinones such as methylone can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and urges to redose.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。甲酮等相關卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠與追加使用的衝動。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。甲酮等相关卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠与追加使用的冲动。

fact.en: MDC is the beta-keto form of MDA, just as methylone is the beta-keto form of MDMA: adding a single oxygen to the side chain turns each amphetamine into a cathinone.
fact.zh: MDC 是 MDA 的 β-酮形式，正如甲酮是 MDMA 的 β-酮形式：在側鏈上加一個氧原子，就把安非他命變成了卡西酮。
fact.zhHans: MDC 是 MDA 的 β-酮形式，正如甲酮是 MDMA 的 β-酮形式：在侧链上加一个氧原子，就把安非他命变成了卡西酮。
